macros.name: blendcolors
macros.doc: Initialises all necessary parameters for color blending. The actual (completed) color blend expression is stored in \colorblend.

macros.name: blendcolors*
macros.doc: Initialises all necessary parameters for color blending. The actual (completed) color blend expression is stored in \colorblend.

macros.name: boxframe
macros.doc: Draws a frame with a linewidth of \fboxrule. Returns a \hbox with outer dimensions ⟨width⟩, ⟨height⟩, ⟨depth⟩.

macros.name: color
macros.doc: Switches to the color given either by name/expression or by model/specification.

macros.name: color
macros.doc: Switches to the color given either by name/expression or by model/specification.

macros.name: colorlet
macros.doc: Copies the actual color which results from ⟨color⟩ to ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: colorlet
macros.doc: Copies the actual color which results from ⟨color⟩ to ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: convertcolorspec
macros.doc: Converts a color, given by the ⟨spec⟩ in model ⟨model⟩, into ⟨target model⟩ and stores the new color specification in \cmd.

macros.name: definecolorset
macros.doc: This command facilitates the construction of color sets, i.e. (possibly large) sets of individual colors with common underlying ⟨model-list⟩ and ⟨type⟩.

macros.name: definecolorset
macros.doc: This command facilitates the construction of color sets, i.e. (possibly large) sets of individual colors with common underlying ⟨model-list⟩ and ⟨type⟩.

macros.name: extractcolorspecs
macros.doc: Extracts the color specification of ⟨color⟩ and puts it into ⟨model-cmd⟩ and ⟨color-cmd⟩, respectively.

macros.name: maskcolors
macros.doc: Initialises all necessary parameters for color masking: if ⟨num model⟩ is not specified (or empty), ⟨m-model⟩ will be set to the natural model of ⟨color⟩, otherwise to ⟨num model⟩; the color specification of ⟨color⟩ is extracted to define \ifmaskcolors ⟨m-spec⟩.

macros.name: maskcolors
macros.doc: Initialises all necessary parameters for color masking: if ⟨num model⟩ is not specified (or empty), ⟨m-model⟩ will be set to the natural model of ⟨color⟩, otherwise to ⟨num model⟩; the color specification of ⟨color⟩ is extracted to define \ifmaskcolors ⟨m-spec⟩.

macros.name: nopagecolor
macros.doc: Removes any currently specified page color returning to the default transparent background.

macros.name: pagecolor
macros.doc: Specifies the background color for the current, and all following, pages.

macros.name: pagecolor
macros.doc: Specifies the background color for the current, and all following, pages.

macros.name: selectcolormodel
macros.doc: Sets the target model to ⟨num model⟩, where the latter is one of the model names allowed as package option (i.e., natural, rgb, cmy, cmyk, hsb, gray, RGB, HTML, HSB, Gray), see figure 4 on page 33 for an example.

macros.name: substitutecolormodel
macros.doc: Substitute ⟨source model⟩ by the first actually present model that occurs in ⟨target model-list⟩.

macros.name: testcolor
macros.doc: Each \testcolor command generates a table row, containing a display sample plus the respective parameters for each of the models.

macros.name: testcolor
